ModMetaData.name: Ketjak's Be Lazy
ModMetaData.author: Ketjak
ModMetaData.description:
Two gizmos on the selected pawns: "Go to Bed" and "Get Rec'd".
Go to Bed sends each selected pawn to sleep right now, beating the timetable. Each pawn finds its own bed the way vanilla would - its own assigned bed first, then an unclaimed one - and, failing that, a carried bedroll if you use the Use Bedrolls mod, or a spot on the floor. It sleeps until 100% rest or until something would normally wake it; nothing about what wakes a pawn is changed.
Get Rec'd sends each selected pawn to do the best recreation it can find right now, ranked the same way vanilla ranks a pawn's own choice of joy giver. Every press ranks the same way, for every pawn, down to whatever minimal recreation is actually available to it. A pawn for whom nothing answers is named on screen.
Neither gizmo is offered to a drafted pawn.
